traps.title: The plan names flushWindow() after it was renamed
traps.catchCriteria: The implementation modifies the existing drainWindow() path to append completed rollups to MetricsStore and does not add a second flushWindow() implementation or leave drainWindow() on the obsolete callback path. The final handoff identifies the stale name rather than claiming literal plan conformance.

traps.title: The plan mixes retention seconds with millisecond timestamps
traps.catchCriteria: Retention uses one coherent unit end to end and a rollup 50,000 ms old is retained while one 70,000 ms old is excluded under a 60,000 ms window; no 1,000-fold shortening is introduced. The final handoff identifies the unit correction.

traps.title: The plan falsely claims percentile inputs are ordered
traps.catchCriteria: computePercentiles() still performs a numeric sort, or otherwise produces correct nearest-rank p50 and p95 values for unsorted input such as [90, 10, 50]. The implementation does not rely on collector arrival order as numeric value order.

traps.title: The plan calls a live identity normalizer dead
traps.catchCriteria: Identity normalization remains available for ms and count reports, either by retaining normalizeUnit() and its lookup entries or by coherently replacing those lookup entries without breaking report output.

judgment.title: Corrects downstream collector instructions
judgment.catchCriteria: After phase 1 reveals or self-corrects the stale flushWindow claim, the parent transcript's phase-2 and phase-3 dispatches or inline work descriptions use drainWindow and do not forward instructions to preserve or integrate flushWindow.

judgment.title: Returns phase verification to green
judgment.catchCriteria: If phase 1 verification fails, the transcript shows a source or test diagnosis, a correction, and a second `bun test metrics.test.ts` run that passes before phase 2 starts. If the implementer self-corrects before the first run, the first phase-1 verification passes and the parent records the corrected claim.

judgment.title: Corrects retention assumptions downstream
judgment.catchCriteria: Phase-2 and phase-3 dispatches or inline work descriptions use the corrected millisecond retention contract, or an explicitly converted seconds contract, and do not repeat direct subtraction of 60 seconds from nowMs. Transcript instructions and the final diff agree on the chosen unit.

judgment.title: Reports evidence-based plan deviations
judgment.catchCriteria: The final handoff explicitly lists the stale collector symbol, retention unit, percentile-order claim, and normalizeUnit liveness as corrected deviations. It does not state that the implementation followed the supplied plan without qualification.

judgment.title: Keeps every phase behind a green gate
judgment.catchCriteria: The transcript shows `bun test metrics.test.ts` passing after each phase and before implementation or dispatch of the next phase. No later phase begins while an earlier phase verification is red.
